meta.title: Resident Evil: The Hive
meta.description: A Resident Evil: The Hive theme — the whole interface becomes the facility's holographic console: near-black and crimson, hexagonal controls, and the Hive itself turning as a live 3D model behind everything. Its decks are widest at the crown and narrow downward; a long bore rises from that crown to the lit hatch at the surface, and a flat rail tunnel on a gentle grade runs out of the widest deck carrying a lit train. Includes the Umbrella canopy as the sidebar brand mark, the Hive schematic in the new-session hero, a hive-link lamp beside the account row, and a pale lab version that follows the app's Appearance setting.
